objective: Close Phase 9 item C26: the tasks of odd/tasks/phase9-c26-review-contract.md, so that labdrian review launch --runtime claude uses the reply contract, diff and preamble of variant V3 of the capsule-lab A/B, measured against gentle-ai's bar on a fresh hold-out.
scope: The specs S1-S6 of odd/tasks/phase9-c26-review-contract.md; one workflow and one role chain for each task.
constraints: The builder builds only a task the shaper designed.
The fresh hold-out is picked mechanically, without reading a defect before the pick, and no hold-out defect enters a design artifact of T2-T4 (S5).
The bar, gentle-ai's recall and prompt bytes on the fresh hold-out, is written in the Log before the first T2 commit and is not changed after (S5).
Gentle-ai and our review are scored by the same rule on the same cases, with prompt bytes from the same shim (S6).
Every commit is reviewed or exempted, and labdrian review check clears it.
non_goals: Applying the location rule to stored results read again (S4).
Changing the role chain before the verdict of T5.
Retuning the contract, diff or preamble on the scores of T5.
acceptance_criteria: T1-T5 of odd/tasks/phase9-c26-review-contract.md are checked off, each with its commit.
The Log holds the bar entry of T1 before the first T2 commit and the verdict entry of T5 against exactly those numbers.
labdrian review check --onto main clears the head of each task's pull request.
runtime_scope: Claude Code, as the parent that runs the labdrian workflow and the role agents.
delivery_boundary: Work-unit commits on the branches of odd/tasks/phase9-c26-review-contract.md; the owner authorized push, pull requests and merges for the shaping branch and T1-T5 (2026-11-02, "autorizo").
